messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up — micro-summit next Wed 10:00–14:00 PT. Partners: NovaCloud (marketplace), FathomHW (edge hardware), IonSI (SI). Plan = 3x 20m partner talks + parallel breakouts: marketplace deep-dive, HW lab, SI hands-on. Need speakers, demo layout, AV, rehearsal slots, and swag distribution.
Miguel Ortega: What does the demo farm look like? How many GPUs / racks do we need on-site vs remote?
Samir Chen: We're reserving 6 GPUs in a Dedicated pool for live demos (low-latency env). Pattern: live endpoint + SI connects to sample app. Fallback = pre-recorded run on S3. I'll author a runbook with prewarm steps and health checks.
Jo Park: Slides & 150-word bio due Mon 09:00 PT. Talks are 20m each (15 talk + 5 Q). Please keep slides to max 10. Are there any NDA/code sensitivity concerns for IonSI?
Elena Rossi: Swag plan: 400 stickers, 150 tees (unisex S-XXL), 60 laptop sleeves. FathomHW is shipping 3 crates (hardware demos) — HTS code 8471.70 for customs. Carrier: DHL Express. ETA to venue: Tue afternoon.
IonSI-demo-bot: Integration repo (private): https://git.company/ion-si/redwood-integ. Demo docker: `docker run -p 8080:8080 ionsi/demo:latest` -> set env REDWOOD_API_KEY. We'll use a canary demo key and rotate after event.
Aisha Patel: Good. Miguel — can you map rooms? Breakout A = Marketplace (webinar stream + live Q), B = HW lab (on-site bench), C = SI hands-on (remote pairing pods). Need AV checklist: 2 lapels, HDMI router, program switcher, 2 displays per room.
Miguel Ortega: AV ticket created #AV-4782. Ordering 2 wired lapel mics, 1 HDMI 4x1 switcher, and 2 extra 4K monitors. Fathom racks require 20A circuits — asking venue for PDUs and outlet mapping. I'll post room map by EOD.
Samir Chen: Demo startup snippet (for rehearsals / runbook):
```
export REDWOOD_KEY=demo-canary
./start-demo.sh --model redwood-rlm-7b --quant=8bit --port=8080 --prewarm=true
# prewarm: curl localhost:8080/predict -d '{"prompt":"seed:42"}'
```
Prewarm and pin seeds so outputs are repeatable during demos. If GPU unavailable, fallback to `s3://redwood-events/micro-summit/demos/demo-fallback.mp4`.
Jo Park: Rehearsal slots = Tue 15:00–18:00 PT. Sign up: https://cal.com/redwood/micro-summit-rehearsal. @Emma (NovaCloud) @Raj (FathomHW) please confirm which slot you want.
Emma (NovaCloud): Confirmed. We'll submit slides + demo stub by Mon 09:00 PT. Demo will show marketplace listing -> 1-click deploy to Redwood Dedicated. Need a short live deploy script.
Raj (FathomHW): We'll bring 2 dev kits and 1 demo rack. Need ethernet handoff and local DHCP. If network flaky, we'll play pre-recorded walkthrough.
Elena Rossi: On-site contact for swag pickup = Marcos (415-555-0123). Need a staffed table and a lockbox for high-value items. Shipping labels: https://files.redwood/swag-labels (internal).
Aisha Patel: Quick action list:
- Jo: collect bios + slides (due Mon 09:00 PT)
- Samir: publish runbook + health checks (link to s3)
- Miguel: final room map + AV checklist (EOD)
- Elena: confirm shipping & customs docs, local pickup contact
- Raj & Emma: confirm gear list and prerecords if needed
Please call out blockers now.
Miguel Ortega: :thumbsup: I'll annotate the room map with power outlets and router locations.
Samir Chen: Uploaded runbook draft -> s3://redwood-events/micro-summit/runbook_v1.md. Key checks in thread:
- Verify REDWOOD_KEY permissions (demo-only, no customer data)
- Prewarm sequence + smoke test (10m before show)
- Fallback flow: swap switcher input to recorded MP4 on network share
Elena Rossi: Customs note: FathomHW crates require commercial invoice + serial numbers. Will attach manifests tonight.
Jo Park: Also need speaker headshots for the web page. Please drop in #marketing-assets by EOD.
Emma (NovaCloud): We'll also want a short marketplace promo (30s) to run between sessions. I'll send asset by Tue noon.
Raj (FathomHW): Confirming contact for on-site network: mathew@venue.net. I'll coordinate static IP allocation.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all — small call tomorrow 10:30 PT to sanity-check runbook after AV map is up. If anyone can't make it, post blockers here.
IonSI-demo-bot: Reminder: rotate demo key after event. Deleting canary key schedule: `aws secretsmanager schedule-secret-deletion --secret-id demo/canary --days 1`
Miguel Ortega: Room map dropped: https://docs.redwood/rooms/micro-summit-map.png (check power labels).
Samir Chen: Final note — we'll record each breakout for post-event asset. Please get speaker permission during rehearsal.
Elena Rossi: Shipping manifests attached in drive. Marcos will be on-site Tue 14:00 to accept.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. Final call tomorrow 10:30 PT. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
